summary: Implemented the window title setting, uncommitted, and verified by reading only. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skipped on legacy Windows), tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only). Nothing committed.
